description: Source code for managing channel sidebar categories in Mattermost, including creation, retrieval, updating, ordering, and deletion of categories, as well as handling category-channel relationships and muting logic.

classes.name: categoryChannelDiff
classes.description: Struct representing the difference in category assignment for a channel.

methods.name: createInitialSidebarCategories
methods.description: Creates initial sidebar categories for a user in a team.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategoriesForTeamForUser
methods.description: Retrieves sidebar categories for a specific user and team, creating defaults if none exist.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategories
methods.description: Retrieves sidebar categories for a user and team, creating defaults if none exist.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategoryOrder
methods.description: Gets the order of sidebar categories for a user and team.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a specific sidebar category by ID.

methods.name: CreateSidebarCategory
methods.description: Creates a new sidebar category and publishes a WebSocket event.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarCategoryOrder
methods.description: Updates the order of sidebar categories and publishes a WebSocket event.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarCategories
methods.description: Updates multiple sidebar categories, publishes an event, and manages channel muting based on category changes.

methods.name: muteChannelsForUpdatedCategories
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes channels based on category muting status changes.

methods.name: diffChannelsBetweenCategories
methods.description: Calculates differences in channel category assignments between two sets of categories.

methods.name: DeleteSidebarCategory
methods.description: Deletes a sidebar category and publishes a WebSocket event.
